scope: Static source/pin and trace review only. No rerun, no actual graph import/build/compile, no numeric model evaluation, no sampler/forecast.

preconditions_before_symbolic_work: provider SHA and selection SHA checked
provider selection validates all pinned dependency bytes
full problem and exact first parent validated against selection
original role manifest rebound and original graph constructed
parent identity, mass 0.125, population_cut_v1 and mass-outside-logp checked
typed exposure port exactly equals original 3x24 parent exposure
control_flow.logp_branch: Complete model.logp(jacobian=True) was constructed. Loop reaches strict_replace_complete_logp. The exact typed port is checked in ancestors, graph_replace(strict=True) is called, then explicit E-input, original-port-removal and transformed-value-input assertions run. The success result is appended only after those assertions; control then proceeds to dlogp. No try/except error log was written for complete_logp.
control_flow.dlogp_branch: At strict_replace_complete_dlogp, the same ancestor precondition `assert port in before` executes outside the try and fails. Thus graph_replace is not called for dlogp.
control_flow.failure_interpretation: Exact original port identity absent from the already-derived gradient graph. This does not show the gradient lacks an equivalent clone/value dependency or is numerically independent of exposure.
control_flow.persistence_limit: The in-memory outcomes list and substituted logp were not serialized; no result.json or replaced graph exists. Logp success is inferred from pinned control flow plus final stage/trace, not independently inspected as an artifact. Postmortem labels itself a reconstruction.

execution_audit.environment: float64, cxx disabled, numba fastmath false, one thread per listed backend, fresh packet-local caches, nice15

gradient_after_logp_review.assessment: Structurally plausible and untested; replacing exact port in complete logp first can avoid relying on its identity in a prederived gradient.
gradient_after_logp_review.jacobian_risk: Must retain `model.logp(jacobian=True)` and PyMC's pre-gradient rewrite. Pinned PyMC Model.dlogp applies `pymc.pytensorf.rewrite_pregrad(cost)` before differentiating. Raw `pt.grad` of replaced logp is not shown to reproduce that path.
gradient_after_logp_review.coordinate_risk: PyMC dlogp flattens each gradient in order of continuous value_vars and concatenates. Any replacement gradient must match the exact ordered segments/vector length and transformed coordinate names.
gradient_after_logp_review.input_identity_risk: After rewrite/gradient derivation, must prove explicit exposure E remains an input, original port/stale parent constant is not retained in ways that create mixed parents, and original value inputs are retained.
gradient_after_logp_review.parent_target_risk: Only original first-parent graph was built. Changing E does not reauthenticate parent ID, mass, row, axes, upstream source or target envelope. The first parent's contract cannot label another parent call.
gradient_after_logp_review.normalization: No conditional normalization evidence; parent masses stay outside conditional logp and require outer parent mixture handling.
required_later_evidence: actual row-0 replaced density/full gradient parity versus fixed-parent baseline
saved point and complete ordered vectors
separately authenticated parent envelope for any other exposure
no scientific qualification from symbolic pass alone

overall_limits: No reason for exact identity failure established; cloning/rewriting/constant transformations remain hypotheses.
No numerical equivalence, linker behavior, full gradient, second-parent execution or target normalization was tested.
Review did not rerun the attempt or inspect/modify caches.
